messages:
Priya N: quick sync 1: product wants a tiny 'notify sensitivity' summary on SLO cards + last override info. need API shape before mockups.
Caleb M: propose single server endpoint GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-status -> flat payload: computed_sensitivity, active_override(actor,ttl), last_action_reason. front-end stays dumb.
Rina S: strongly prefer server-side composition to avoid drift during rollout. cap any explain list to 3 entries to keep payload small.
Alex G: add cost showback as a tiny badge: last_1h_est_cost (number+currency) with link. pre-computed snapshot only to avoid high cardinality.
Priya N: override UX: product wants "Reduce alerts" button that POSTs /v1/tenants/:id/overrides with TTL. need guardrails.
Caleb M: guardrails: dev roles -> max 4h, owners -> max 72h; all overrides emit immutable audit events. server enforces auth + TTL.
Rina S: also rate-limit override POSTs per tenant and strip any PII from explain steps. actor must be id/handle only.
telemetry-bot: synthetic-check: notify-eval event emitted for sandbox-21 at 3456789150 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Alex G: console should show computed_policy and explain_chain (short list) and last_applied_reason; if runtime applied fallback, show that chain so teams understand why no page fired.
Priya N: rollout: stage1 read-only notify-status in console; stage2 enable overrides for sandboxes; stage3 gated prod override with admin + audit retention.
Caleb M: will draft OpenAPI for GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-status and POST /v1/tenants/:id/overrides with sample responses. include cost snapshot and a 3-item explain array.
Rina S: QA plan: canary that synthesizes SLO breach, verify explain_chain contains fallback reason and cost badge within 5% of billing snapshots. also confirm no email addresses in payloads.
Priya N: thanks all 10 I'll create the ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-platform, label `slo-console-surface` and target next milestone.
